New Delhi: Union Minister Prataprao Jadhav on Wednesday urged people to adopt healthy lifestyle practices, saying naturopathy can play an important role in strengthening preventive healthcare and building a healthy India.In a video message on the 9th Naturopathy Day, celebrated under the theme 'Prakritik Chikitsa, Swasth Bharat', Jadhav said naturopathy and healthy lifestyles were essential for preventive healthcare.

He also appreciated the efforts of practitioners, researchers, institutions and other stakeholders in promoting naturopathy and creating greater public awareness about the system.The national-level celebration was organised by the Central Council for Research in Yoga and Naturopathy (CCRYN), under the Ministry of Ayush, in collaboration with the National Institute of Naturopathy (NIN), Pune, at the Central Research Institute of Yoga and Naturopathy (CRIYN) in Nagamangala, Karnataka.

Advt

Ayush Secretary Vaidya Rajesh Kotecha, in his video message, stressed the importance of scientific research, health awareness and community participation in advancing naturopathy.He encouraged citizens to adopt informed and sustainable health practices, highlighting the role of naturopathy in preventive healthcare and promoting harmony with nature.

Karnataka Minister for Water Resources N Cheluvarayaswamy, who attended the programme as the chief guest, highlighted the potential of CRIYN Nagamangala to address the healthcare needs of the region and stressed the need to make its facilities accessible to the general public.

The programme also saw the release of several research publications and educational resources, including ReGEN-Beta, a clinical trial on lifestyle interventions for Type 2 diabetes, and the Indian Journal of Yoga and Naturopathy (Volume 1, Issue 3).

The NIN, Pune, released 'Nature Cure 360: A Community Health Initiative towards a Sustainable Healthy Future' and 'The Family Doctor'.A naturopathy food fair and a medicinal plant plantation drive were also organised as part of the celebrations.
